title: finding(plugin-form): the default `object-form` arm draws a section's members in field-pool order, not the order the section lists them; the other five arms keep the section's order
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, read at source. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from objectui#10254 (PR objectui#10451). Its dev and both contract reviews of that PR recorded this and left it out of scope on purpose. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

With explicit `sections`, the default `object-form` arm (`SimpleObjectForm` in `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`) resolves each section's members with a name filter over the parent field pool:

```ts
const sectionFields = applyFieldPerms(sourceFields.filter(f => sectionFieldNames.includes(f.name)))
```

The members come out in POOL order (the order of `schema.fields`, or of the object's fields merged with `customFields`), not in the order the section lists them. The `drawer`, `modal`, `tabbed`, `wizard` and `split` arms build a section through `buildSectionFields`, which maps `section.fields` in the authored order. So the same `sections` block lays out differently depending on `formType`. On the default arm, an author who writes `fields: ['due_date', 'title']` in a section gets `title` first whenever the pool lists it first.

## Evidence

- Read at source on objectui `origin/main`: the filter line above, and `buildSectionFields` / `normalizeSectionField` in `sectionFields.ts`.
- The objectui#10254 dev and the PR objectui#10451 reviews recorded the same reading.
- ⛔ Not probed by the seat.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The likely direction is to iterate the section's names and look each one up in the pool, keeping objectui#9884's intersection (a name the pool lacks is still dropped, with its warning). That would make the default arm agree with the other five.
- The pool also decides values, create defaults and the submitted set (objectui#9884's note), so only the LAYOUT order should move.
- Pin: a two-member section listed in reverse pool order renders in the section's order on all six arms.
- Sibling card, filed in the same act: the default arm also drops section-entry overrides.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern "section" near pool order / field order / order of, near simple / default arm / `ObjectForm`, or `sectionFieldNames` ⇒ 1 hit, objectui#9884 (closed; the `fields` / `sections` intersection, not order). The control `sectionFieldNames` is lit through objectui#9884.

Dedupe words: `section member order default arm` · `SimpleObjectForm sections pool order` · `sectionFieldNames filter order` · `object-form sections reorder formType`
